edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the default targetAddress when none is supplied in buy.
msg.sender is used as the default seller/target and as the token source in sell.
Minting authorization in _mintGoodDollars is derived from _msgSender().
setGDXAirdrop is gated by _onlyAvatar against msg.sender.
setReserveRatioDailyExpansion is gated by _onlyAvatar against msg.sender.
end is gated by _onlyAvatar against msg.sender.
recover is gated by _onlyAvatar against msg.sender.
_tokenAmount flows into buy and is forwarded to the market maker and transferFrom.
_minReturn bounds the accepted G$ return in buy.
_targetAddress selects the G$/GDX recipient in buy.
_gdAmount is burned and used for the contribution/return computation in sell.
_target receives the cDAI return in sell.
_seller is used for GDX balance and discount accounting in sell.
_user is hashed into the leaf and receives the minted GDX in claimGDX.
_daiToConvert is supplied to cERC20.mint inside mintUBI.
_nom feeds the reserve ratio expansion computation.
_denom feeds the reserve ratio expansion computation.
_token is the ERC20 transferred out in recover.
gdReturn is the local result of the market maker call in buy.
contributionAmount is the exit contribution computed in sell.
tokenReturn is the cDAI amount produced and transferred in sell.
interestInCdai is the balance delta used to mint interest in mintUBI.
leafHash is the merkle leaf verified in claimGDX.
buy calls transferFrom on the input token to pull the payer funds.
_mintGoodDollars performs the privileged IGoodDollar.mint call.
sell calls burnFrom on the GoodDollar token for the caller.
sell burns GDX used for the exit-contribution discount.
sell transfers the cDAI return to the target.
end transfers remaining cDAI to the avatar.
recover transfers the full token balance to the avatar.
_mintGDX performs the privileged GDX _mint.
buy invokes _mintGoodDollars to mint the purchased G$.
buy invokes _mintGDX to mint matching GDX.
mintRewardFromRR invokes _mintGoodDollars for rewards.
mintRewardFromRR invokes _mintGDX for rewards.
mintUBI invokes _mintGoodDollars for the UBI and interest amount.
claimGDX invokes _mintGDX for the proven airdrop amount.
initialize calls setAddresses to resolve and approve tokens.
buy resolves the market maker via getMarketMaker.
sell resolves the market maker via getMarketMaker.
setAddresses writes the DAI address.
setAddresses writes the cDAI address and approves it.
setGDXAirdrop writes the airdrop merkle root.
claimGDX sets isClaimedGDX to prevent double claims.
claimGDX reads gdxAirdrop as the merkle root.
_mintGoodDollars enforces the cap on the total G$ supply.
mintUBI records the current block number in lastMinted.
buy reads cDaiAddress as the input token.
sell reads cDaiAddress as the output token.
currentPriceDAI reads the cDAI exchange rate from cDaiAddress.
mintUBI mints cDAI through the cDaiAddress contract.
The external transferFrom call can re-enter buy before state finalization.
A malicious input token transferFrom can re-enter sell.
The external cERC20.transfer can re-enter sell before returning.
The external ERC20.transfer in recover can re-enter the contract.

normalization_plan.reason: _tokenAmount is only meaningful as the buy input amount.
_minReturn only bounds the buy return check.
gdReturn is the transient result of the buy market maker call.
_gdAmount only drives the sell burn and computation.
_target only receives the sell cDAI return.
_seller only parameterizes the sell discount accounting.
contributionAmount is the transient exit contribution in sell.
tokenReturn is the transient cDAI return value in sell.
_user only parameterizes the airdrop leaf and mint recipient.
_daiToConvert only feeds the cDAI mint in mintUBI.
interestInCdai is a transient balance delta in mintUBI.
_nom only feeds the ratio update computation.
_denom only feeds the ratio update computation.
_token only selects the ERC20 transferred out in recover.
leafHash is a transient merkle leaf built in claimGDX.
